mapper.select: select r.id, r.order_id as orderId, r.rating, r.content, r.create_time as createTime, coalesce(p.nickname, u.nick_name) as reviewerNickname, p.avatar as reviewerAvatar from sm_order_review r left join sm_user_profile p on r.reviewer_id = p.user_id left join sys_user u on r.reviewer_id = u.user_id where r.reviewee_id = #{sellerId} order by r.create_time desc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}
select count(*) from sm_order_review where reviewee_id = #{sellerId}
